أحقق (form I)
# أَحْقِقْ (ʔaḥqiq) /ʔaħ.qiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# أَحْقُقْ (ʔaḥquq) /ʔaħ.quq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# أُحْقَقْ (ʔuḥqaq) /ʔuħ.qaq/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
